primary_endpoint: Access site-related major or minor vascular complications at 30 days.
efficacy_outcome: Vascular complications: 10% with MANTA vs. 4% with ProGlide (p = 0.16). Modified VCD failure: 20% vs. 40%, respectively (p < 0.01).
safety_signal: Clinically significant access site bleeding: 9% with MANTA vs. 6% with ProGlide (p = 0.57).
